post.originalText:
Claude Fable 5.2 came out today, so I gave it and Opus 5.5 the exact same prompt: build a 3D flying game.

One try each. No help.

Opus 5.5: 14 min, $2.42
Fable 5.2: 24 min, $2.57
(cost at API prices)

Both work. Which one looks better? 👇

Frequently asked questions
Straight answers about how FlowAI works, what it costs and how the trial works.
What is FlowAI Social?
+FlowAI Social, also called FlowAI, is comment and DM automation for Instagram and Facebook. When someone comments a keyword you choose on your post, FlowAI replies to the comment and sends them a direct message with your link or offer. It can also collect emails and phone numbers with the person's consent and gives you one inbox to answer messages. You can set it up by hand or by talking to ChatGPT, Claude or another AI agent.
How does comment-to-DM automation work?
+You pick a keyword, write the public reply and the direct message, and choose which posts it applies to. When a follower comments that keyword, FlowAI posts your reply and sends the DM. The reply and the DM are two separate steps, and you write both messages. You can add a short delay so replies look natural, and rotate up to three versions of each message.
Which accounts does FlowAI work with?
+FlowAI works with Instagram Business and Creator accounts and with Facebook Pages. You can switch an Instagram account to Business or Creator for free in the Instagram app under Settings, then Account type. Personal Instagram profiles aren't supported by Meta's automation tools.
Is FlowAI approved by Meta?
+Yes. Meta has approved FlowAI's app for the Instagram and Facebook features it uses, and our business is verified with Meta.
Do I have to give FlowAI my Instagram password?
+No. You connect by logging in with Meta (Instagram or Facebook) and choosing what to share. FlowAI uses Meta's official APIs, never asks for your password, and you can disconnect any time.
How much does FlowAI cost?
+Plans are Starter $29, Growth $79 and Pro $199 per month, or about 17% less when billed yearly (Starter $289 a year, Growth $787 a year, Pro $1,982 a year). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial.
How does the free trial work?
+Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial. You set up your account and your first automation, then add a card to start the trial. You aren't charged during the trial, and if you cancel before it ends you pay nothing. After 3 days your card is charged for the plan you chose, and you can cancel any time from Billing. Payments are non-refundable.
Can I set up FlowAI from ChatGPT or Claude?
+Yes. FlowAI includes an MCP server, so you can connect ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or any MCP-compatible agent by signing in and clicking Allow. Your agent can then see your connected accounts, create, edit, pause and delete automations, check what ran, and look up contacts. Anything an agent builds before your trial starts is saved switched off until you start it.
Can my team use FlowAI together?
+Yes. You can invite teammates by email from Profile, then Team. Each person gets their own login, and they share your plan's connected accounts and contacts. Seats include you: Starter 2, Growth 3 and Pro 10. Only the workspace owner manages billing.
What counts as an active contact?
+An active contact is a person you message in a month: someone who receives a DM from one of your automations, or who messages you first. Each person counts once per month, no matter how many messages they get. People who only comment on a post and aren't messaged don't count.
Can I cancel any time?
+Yes. You can cancel from Billing at any time. Your plan stays active until the end of the trial or the period you've paid for. All payments are non-refundable, including after a renewal.
